author.name: Requirements Reuben
author.role: Architects secure and scalable production ML systems. Defines security requirements, ensures privacy compliance, and manages data governance. Conducts rigorous testing and validation to guarantee high product quality.

challenge.name: The Consent Gap
challenge.description: A new model version requires loyalty basket data, but the deployment pipeline lacks the governance controls to verify consent. #automation_alex# wants to push the automated deployment forward immediately to meet the promotion deadline, while #requirements_reuben# insists on a manual review process to ensure legal compliance. #automation_alex# is open to adding a manual approval step if it keeps the pipeline moving, but #requirements_reuben# will not accept any automated path without full audit trails.

output.content: I need to be explicit about the deployment path for the new loyalty basket model. We cannot move to an automated pipeline until every consent check is captured in a full, immutable audit trail. If the system cannot prove that each data point was accessed under valid consent, the entire automated path is a non starter for me. I will not sign off on any workflow that skips this verification, regardless of the promotion deadline pressure. We can keep the current manual review process running as the only valid route until the audit logging is complete and verified. There is no compromise on this point; without the trail, there is no deployment.
output.reclassify_reason: The author explicitly states they will not sign off on any workflow that skips consent verification and that there is no compromise, establishing a strict line whose crossing constitutes refusal.
